newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Meiya first half net up four percent.
newsitem.headline: Meiya first half net up four percent.

text.p: Wool blanket producer Guangdong Meiya Co Ltd said it posted interim net profit of 83.99 million yuan in the first half of 1996, up four percent from the January-June period of 1995.

Under Chinese accounting standards, the company had main operating income of 408.11 million yuan, down from the year earlier level of 418.71 million yuan, Meiya said an interim report published in the official Shenzhen Securities Times.
The company said the slightly higher first-half earnings were due to its efforts to step up the production of higher-priced wool blankets and reduce production costs.

A company spokeswoman told the China Securities Bulletin that Meiya's shareholders have approved the firm's plan to make a three-for-10 rights offer at a meeting held in Heshan in southern China's Guangdong province on August 24.
The offer, tentatively priced at between four yuan and six yuan per rights share, still requires the final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the spokeswoman said.
She said the Shenzhen-listed company aims to use the proceeds to expand its blanket production lines.
